|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Merc Sunlet (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. While you have more cards in your Lost Pile than your opponent, and you are about to lose Force, you may use X Force and place X cards of your choice from your Lost Pile out of play to reduce Force loss by X. You may not play Out Of Commission. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Out Of Commission is canceled. Unless opponent has more cards in Lost Pile than you, whenever you lose Force, may use X Force and place any X cards from your Lost Pile out of play to reduce the loss by X. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “While you have” → “Out Of Commission is canceled. Unless opponent has”; removed “your”; “your opponent, and” → “you, whenever”; removed “are about to”; removed “you”; added “any”; removed “of your choice”; “Force” → “the”; “You may not play Out Of Commission. [Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 15. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Merc Sunlet]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Merc Sunlet (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Merc Sunlet]]. For the later Virtual Block 1 printing, see [[Merc Sunlet (V)]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_15.
